# Data Source: stripe_billing_credit_grant

Billing credits given to a customer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stripe_billing_credit_grant" "welcome" {
  id = stripe_billing_credit_grant.welcome.id
}
```

## Argument Reference

This data source supports the following arguments:

* `id` - (Required) The ID of the billing credit grant to read.

## Attribute Reference

This data source exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `amount` - Amount of this credit grant. See [`amount`](#amount) below.
* `applicability_config` - Configuration specifying what this credit grant applies to. We currently only support `metered` prices that have a [Billing Meter](https://docs.stripe.com/api/billing/meter) attached to them. See [`applicability_config`](#applicability_config) below.
* `category` - The category of this credit grant. It defaults to `paid` if not specified. Possible values: `paid`, `promotional`.
* `created` - Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
* `customer` - ID of the customer receiving the billing credits.
* `customer_account` - ID of the account representing the customer receiving the billing credits.
* `effective_at` - The time when the billing credits become effective-when they're eligible for use. It defaults to the current timestamp if not specified.
* `expires_at` - The time when the billing credits expire. If not specified, the billing credits don't expire.
* `livemode` - If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
* `metadata` - Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object. You can use this to store additional information about the object (for example, cost basis) in a structured format.
* `name` - A descriptive name shown in the Dashboard.
* `priority` - The desired priority for applying this credit grant. If not specified, it will be set to the default value of 50. The highest priority is 0 and the lowest is 100.
* `test_clock` - ID of the test clock this credit grant belongs to.
* `updated` - Time at which the object was last updated. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
* `voided_at` - The time when this credit grant was voided. If not present, the credit grant hasn't been voided.

<a id="amount"></a>
### `amount`

The `amount` attribute supports:

* `monetary` - The monetary amount. See [`amount.monetary`](#amount.monetary) below.
* `type` - The type of this amount. We currently only support `monetary` billing credits. Possible values: `monetary`.

<a id="amount.monetary"></a>
### `amount.monetary`

The `amount.monetary` attribute supports:

* `currency` - Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).
* `value` - A positive integer representing the amount.

<a id="applicability_config"></a>
### `applicability_config`

The `applicability_config` attribute supports:

* `scope` - See [`applicability_config.scope`](#applicability_config.scope) below.

<a id="applicability_config.scope"></a>
### `applicability_config.scope`

The `applicability_config.scope` attribute supports:

* `price_type` - The price type that credit grants can apply to. We currently only support the `metered` price type. This refers to prices that have a [Billing Meter](https://docs.stripe.com/api/billing/meter) attached to them. Cannot be used in combination with `prices`. Possible values: `metered`.
* `prices` - The prices that credit grants can apply to. We currently only support `metered` prices. This refers to prices that have a [Billing Meter](https://docs.stripe.com/api/billing/meter) attached to them. Cannot be used in combination with `price_type`. See [`applicability_config.scope.prices`](#applicability_config.scope.prices) below.

<a id="applicability_config.scope.prices"></a>
### `applicability_config.scope.prices`

The `applicability_config.scope.prices` attribute is a list. Each element supports:

* `id` - Unique identifier for the object.
